info.name: Assessment Service Assessment Groups userroles API

params.name: assetUid
params.description: Unique identifier for an asset.

params.name: perPage
params.description: Requested page size for pagination. A server-selected default of 100 will be used when no perPage is requested via query parameter.

params.name: page
params.description: Page to retrieve in paginated response. A server-selected default of 1 will be used when no page is requested via query parameter.

params.name: sort
params.description: Optional property to sort results by.

params.name: sortDir
params.description: Direction of sort-order for items in the response.

params.name: scannable
params.description: Constrains the response to include users roles with a matching value for the scannable property.
